claims: Earth Day is observed annually on April 22.
Earth Day marks the anniversary of the birth of the modern environmental movement in 1970.
Earth Day is a global event dedicated to environmental protection.
Earth Day was first held on April 22, 1970.
Millions of Americans rallied for environmental reform on April 22, 1970.
Earth Day events include local clean-ups.
Earth Day events include educational workshops.
Earth Day events include tree planting.
Earth Day events include sustainability initiatives.
Many organizations and communities host special "Party for the Planet" events around April 22.
